entries.title: Zed AI / Zeta2 architecture deep-dive
entries.summary: How Zed's Zeta2 is built: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B base, knowledge distillation from Claude Sonnet 4.6 teacher, real edit traces.

todos.text: Update nanochat PREFERRED_MODEL_TAGS to include qwen3:8b and gpt-oss-20b
Follow Zeta2 distillation recipe with local teacher (devstral/qwen3:8b)
Pull Zeta2 weights from HuggingFace as reference

messages.content: what model is zed built trained off of

Two separate systems: (1) Zeta2 edit prediction = Qwen2.5-Coder-7B base, distilled from Claude Sonnet 4.6 teacher, 100K examples, open weights. (2) Agent Panel = API passthrough to Claude/GPT/Gemini. You have Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-MLX locally — exact same base as Zeta2.

messages.content: added two new via LM Studio [@library]
Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-MLX-4bit (4GB, Qwen2 arch, 28L/3584d, 152K vocab) — identical base to Zed Zeta2. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-MLX-4bit (5.4GB, qwen3_vl arch) — vision+language, MLX native.

entries.title: Model VC gap analysis + growth roadmap to Zed AI
entries.summary: Version control gap: nanochat-demo has no git. Iron Line manifest exists in 00-mu. Full stack map from nanochat micro → Zeta-equivalent → Agent Panel.

todos.text: git init /Volumes/qbitOS/03.models/nanochat-demo && add .gitignore for large .pt files
Set up DVC for checkpoint + training data versioning
Populate Iron Line manifest (00-mu/02-model/09-manifests) with current model inventory
Wire /models page in train/ to live Ollama API instead of static mock data
Add /offline page to train/ — live model selector + prompt capture → training pair
Grow nanochat: depth 8-12L, 512 seq len, 32K vocab

messages.content: where is version control for models and what models am i missing that could build on my concept to grow to Zed Ai/ Zeta / Agent Panel and beyond

VC gap: nanochat-demo, training_data, 00-mu have no git. You already designed Iron Line manifest. Real model VC = git+LFS or DVC. Missing models: llama3.2:1b (fast), nomic-embed-text (RAG), qwen3:8b (reasoning), deepseek-r1:7b (CoT). Growth path: nanochat 4L → 12L → Qwen2.5-Coder base → Zeta2 equivalent.
